prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: FULL-HEIGHT portrait sidebar background for an existing midnight pixel-art coaching reading page.
Primary request: extend/recompose the supplied coastal bench artwork into a tall 768 by 2048 portrait canvas. It must be a continuous illustrated landscape from the very top edge to the very bottom edge. No blank bands, no vignette, no fade into a flat color.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, the selected artwork. Preserve the specific two adult peers, their independent upright seated postures, their clear empty gap, Willis's navy T-shirt/khaki shorts/gesture, the other adult's dark hoodie and open notebook, the weathered bench, lantern, tote with sloth charm, and the detailed pixel-art rendering. This is a vertical extension/framing task, not a new character design.
Scene and framing: retain the same tree-framed blue coastal overlook, evening sea, distant headlands and subtle copper-blue horizon. Extend the tree canopy and richly layered dark navy sky upward, and extend the rocky grassy path downward. Reframe horizontally around the EXISTING bench group so BOTH people, all their limbs, the open notebook, lantern, tote and entire bench fit within the central 80% of the portrait width, leaving modest side margins. Put the top of their heads at about 57% of total canvas height, and the lantern base at about 79%; their bench belongs around 73%. Keep the top 42% quiet, filled with real dim navy sky, subdued clouds, distant coastal scenery and tree branches, because navigation overlays this area. Essential content is beneath that overlay.
Invariants: visibly generous personal space between the two adults, independent seated posture, no touching, no leaning toward each other, no romance. Keep the man on the left, notebook-holder on the right as in the original. One lantern on the ground, tote left. Keep both figures complete, viewed from behind. Preserve the professional peer conversation.
Style: match original high-quality handcrafted 16-bit pixel-art adventure-game background; square pixel clusters, stepped edges, detailed dithered foliage and layered deep blue water. Match its navy/teal/amber palette exactly. No smooth anime line art, no painterly brushwork, no low-poly or vector rendering, no photography.
Constraints: exactly two adults; no extra props, text, logos, watermark, UI, frames or borders. No gradients into empty navy around the outer edges. Artwork fills the whole portrait. Avoid a large moon or spectacular sunset.
integration: Full-height coaching.html sidebar, shared cover treatment. Original wide source retained for mobile and social preview.
